package.description: Create PDFs from almost any application

en-US.description: Create PDFs from almost any application
en-US.longDescription:
Just click Print and select CutePDF Writer as your printer. It’s that simple.
1. Select a file in any application that prints and open it.
2. Choose “File” > “Print”.
3. Choose “CutePDF Writer” as the printer in the print dialog box, and click “Print”.
   (Do Not select "Print to File" option.)
4. Enter a new file name for your PDF and select options. “Save” to your desired location.
en-US.name: CutePDF Writer

zh-CN.description: 从几乎任何应用程序创建 PDF
zh-CN.longDescription:
只需点击打印，然后选择 CutePDF Writer 作为您的打印机。就是这么简单。
1. 在任何可打印的应用程序中选择并打开一个文件。
2. 选择“文件”>“打印”。
3. 在打印对话框中选择“CutePDF Writer”作为打印机，然后单击“打印”。
   (不要选择“打印到文件”选项）。
4. 为 PDF 输入新的文件名并选择选项。“保存”到您想要的位置。
